_comment: INSTALL-06 — pinned third-party binary versions for the assembled Windows runtime package. Neither vendor publishes an official SHA256 for these specific archives (verified during the INSTALL-06 audit) — sha256 values below are self-established: downloaded once, sanity-checked (file version/size/content, matching the pinned version exactly), hashed, and committed here as the trusted value all future automated builds verify against. scripts/fetchWindowsRuntimeDependencies.js refuses to run against a still-placeholder value — it never treats an unverified download as trusted.

postgresql._urlNote: EDB's real download URL is https://sbp.enterprisedb.com/getfile.jsp?fileid=<opaque numeric id> (confirmed via a third-party open-source acquisition script that documents this exact mechanism) — the id is only discoverable by loading the landing page above, which returned HTTP 403 to every access method tried in this session (both a dedicated web-fetch tool and PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest, against both the '-binaries' page and the general downloads page). NOT guessed — still unresolved, see migration/reports/INSTALL-06_INSTALLER_DESIGN.md for the full trace.

nssm._verifiedNote: Downloaded for real, extracted, and sanity-checked in this session: win64\nssm.exe reports FileVersion '2.24-101-g897c7ad', ProductName 'NSSM 64-bit', CompanyName 'Iain Patterson' (the real NSSM author) — matches the pinned version exactly. Not code-signed (expected/normal for NSSM releases — this checksum is the compensating control).
